answer: Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. Each submission hangs on the echo of a task receipt, and the copper is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, reduced by each unverified claim, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the sparrow of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
